svg.title: Signal Timing Analyzers overview
svg.desc: Check periodic signals used to confirm normal operation of a marine control and monitoring module, and make timing deviations and selected noise/glitch conditions visible during Type Approval testing. Flow: Captured transitions; Edge / glitch checks; Frequency / frame checks; Annotated exports

g.text: Turn operating-status pulses into inspectable timing evidence
